q: In September 2023, what multiplier was paid for ordinary overtime beyond the forty-hour week? Answer under the version of the overtime rate that was in force on that date.
log:
DONE

The multiplier in force for ordinary overtime (beyond the 40-hour week) in September 2023 was **+50% (1.5×)** the hourly basic pay rate, per the `payslip-overtime` document in payroll, which was the version in effect until 2024-07-01.
